options.tradeoff: `ekumen claim --takeover <role>` (lead lane) releases the old holder and records the new claim. Claims must use a session id that isn't a generic word (main, default), and check warns otherwise. Liveness from the adapter can come later.
Claims expire unless renewed on each write. Automatic, but a slow session silently loses its role.
The loop releases claims whose session the adapter reports dead. Needs a working adapter first.

data.question: A role claim clears only when its holder releases it (GitHub #13). A crashed orchestrator blocks every orchestrator write. Two sessions also both claimed as "orchestrator:main", so the claim protected nothing. How are claims broken, and how are holders told apart?
data.title: How a stuck or duplicated role claim is broken
